Principais atribuições:

Gerenciar e priorizar demandas em times cross que habilitam produto e negócio de forma previsível, evitando retrabalhos e com alta qualidade.

Aplicar práticas de governança nos times cross, garantindo cadência, previsibilidade e transparência nas entregas que suportam os produtos de negócio.

Definir, acompanhar e analisar KPIs de fluxo (lead time, throughput, incidentes, disponibilidade, adoção de plataforma), conectando desempenho técnico ao impacto nos produtos de negócio.

Atuar na gestão do fluxo de valor de plataformas e serviços técnicos, identificando gargalos entre times cross e desenvolvimento e puxando melhorias de ponta a ponta.

Promover melhoria contínua dos processos de entrega, apoiando iniciativas de padronização, automação e autosserviço para squads de desenvolvimento.

Equilibrar demandas estratégicas (evolução de plataforma, segurança, escalabilidade) e operacionais (incidentes, requests, manutenção), garantindo sustentabilidade e evolução no médio e longo prazo.

  • Mentalidade orientada a dados, melhoria contínua e colaboração, com conforto em atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e dependências.

Localização desta posição: Híbrido no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Oferecemos autonomia, objetivos claros e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm a oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) de qualquer lugar do mundo. Quais são os nossos valores?

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou outras. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e cheio de oportunidades.

Av. Theodomiro Porto da Fonseca

title: Sr Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Reporting to the Solution Consulting Director and based in Brazil, the candidate will be responsible for all technical aspects of the sales cycle related to geomodelling solutions, while ensuring the highest standard of customer satisfaction. The candidate will play a key role in the development and execution of pre-sales activities for geomodelling workflows, with deep expertise in SKUA, RMS, and subsurface characterization.

Your Impact

  • Provide advanced technical support and consulting in Aspen SKUA and Aspen RMS geomodelling software.
  • Prepare, present, and propose workflows for structural modeling, property modeling, seismic interpretation integration, reservoir characterization, and uncertainty analysis.
  • Search, uncover, understand, and analyze client/prospect needs and requirements to grow or penetrate accounts.
  • Conduct technical presentations and demonstrations on the AspenTech SSE subsurface applications suite, with emphasis on SKUA and RMS.
  • Present integrated workflows combining geomodelling software with other tools in the AspenTech suite (e.g., seismic interpretation, petrophysics, flow simulation).
  • Conduct pilot projects showcasing geomodelling workflows, demonstrating differentiators of SKUA/RMS versus equivalent market solutions.
  • Co-develop sales proposals together with the sales team.
  • Run advanced demonstrations and presentations at customer sites, workshops, and trade shows.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend proof-of-concept and evaluation opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with users through personal contact, onsite engagements, and user group meetings.
  • Communicate with product managers and developers on issues identified from field observations and customer feedback.
  • Training – Deliver high-quality basic and advanced training on geomodelling workflows and modules within SKUA and RMS.
  • Support – Provide troubleshooting and advanced user assistance; own issues until resolution or appropriate escalation. Demonstrate proficiency with internal support procedures and tracking systems.
  • Professional Development – Continue to actively develop technical expertise in geomodelling methodologies, reservoir characterization, and integrated subsurface workflows. Seek opportunities for personal development of non-technical competencies.
  • Technical Reporting – Complete and submit Consultant Activity Reports after each project in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to R&D and Product Management to contribute to continued improvement of our geoscience solutions.
  • Software Consulting – Deliver consulting services to execute tasks and produce deliverables related to structural modeling, reservoir modeling, seismic-to-simulation workflows, and geomodelling.
  • Write papers or technical abstracts for local and international events, demonstrating the value of AspenTech SSE geomodelling technologies.

What You'll Need

  • BS in Geology, Reservoir Engineering, or related subsurface discipline; MS preferred with more than 5–7 years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of geomodeling, reservoir characterization, structural modeling, property modeling, and uncertainty workflows.
  • Experience working with complex geological settings such as carbonates, unconventionals, tight sands, salt tectonics, and structurally complex reservoirs.
  • Expertise in handling subsurface datasets: seismic interpretations, well logs, geological maps, core data, and reservoir simulation grids.
  • Capable of conducting high-quality basic and advanced classroom training on SKUA and RMS modules and workflows.
  • Background in multidisciplinary collaboration to improve integrated interpretation and modeling results.
  • Experience with data management, quality control, and subsurface data integration workflows.
  • Proficiency with geomodeling applications, especially SKUA and RMS (mandatory).
  • Knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Excellent technical communication skills in English; Portuguese and Spanish strongly preferred.
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and willing to take initiative.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team when required.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor younger professionals.
  • Able to interact effectively with other departments and multidisciplinary colleagues.
  • Strong commitment to deadlines and customer satisfaction.
  • Comfortable working in a multicultural business environment.
  • Flexible – must be able to travel.

Trabalhará de forma transversal com diferentes equipes, garantindo que todos os projetos sob sua gestão sejam entregues dentro do prazo, escopo (qualidade) e orçamento. description:
Overview

Please note: this hybrid position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating to Rio de Janeiro.

About The Role

Uber's Gifting business is a rapidly expanding global initiative, and we are just getting started. We are looking for a Software Engineer, iOS to help us build the future of connection. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-visibility initiative that operates like a startup within Uber. As a Software Engineer, iOS on the Gifting team, you will be hands-on in the code, building the features that transform Gifting from a seasonal add-on into a "first-class use case" deeply integrated into the Rides and Eats apps. You will work on tangible, user-facing products—designing systems that are not only scalable but also secure and compliant across global markets.

What The Candidate Will Do

  • Build Delightful UI/UX: Engineer high-fidelity, native and hybrid experiences. Write performant code that handles heavy assets (videos, images) without compromising app start time or scroll performance
  • Bridge Native & Web: Seamlessly integrate mobile web technologies into the native app experience, ensuring feature parity and smooth transitions between native and web views.
  • Integrate Across Apps: Implement gifting surfaces that live within both the main Uber app and the Uber Eats app, ensuring a consistent experience across Mobility and Delivery contexts.
  • Ensure Code Quality & Reliability: Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code. You will contribute to product reliability.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers from other teams to ensure your features integrate seamlessly into the Uber apps.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in software development.
  • Strong Coding Ability: Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Swift, Objective C, C)
  • UI/UX Passion: Strong eye for detail and experience building complex, custom user interfaces that go beyond standard OS components.
  • Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively within a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Mobile Web Willingness: Innovative mindset with a willingness to work across the stack, specifically with mobile web technologies. You must be open to building and debugging hybrid views (WebView, Bridge integration) as we expand experiences to web channels.
  • Full-Stack Exposure: Comfort working across the stack (backend APIs and basic frontend/mobile integration) to deliver end-to-end features.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Experience integrating applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) or conversational AI interfaces to drive product discovery and user engagement.
  • Product-Centric Mindset: A passion for building consumer-facing products and an interest in user experience (e.g., helping users find the perfect "birthday brunch" or "thank you gift").

title: Senior Partner Sales Manager - Global System Integrator (GSI)
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Global System Integrators (GSI) play a crucial role in Canonical growth plans in the coming 3 years. We are hiring a Senior Partner Sales Manager to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu‑based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long term digital transformation platforms with Ubuntu stacks and services.

Working the Partner Sales Director in their geographic region, the Senior Partner Sales Manager will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships with partners at levels, and stickiness with Ubuntu technology
  • Deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
  • Ability to travel - sometimes internationally - up to 40% of the time

What we are looking for in you

  • Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast‑paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Atividades

Preparar especificações técnicas para sistemas submarinos de flexíveis e umbilicais e sua instalação, em colaboração com especialistas da matriz da TotalEnergies.

Gerenciar esclarecimentos técnicos dentro das disciplinas e entre os fornecedores de SURF e as contratadas de instalação.

Supervisionar as atividades de engenharia relacionadas ao projeto dos sistemas de flexíveis e umbilicais e à instalação do sistema SURF, com foco especial em layout, expansão térmica, análises mecânicas e dinâmicas globais, definição da configuração de risers, instalação e pré‑comissionamento.

Revisar e comentar a documentação de engenharia dos fornecedores de URF e das contratadas de instalação , considerando os documentos contratuais de referência.

Supervisionar atividades de aquisição, fabricação, testes e instalação relacionadas à disciplina.

Auxiliar no acompanhamento de todos os aspectos da construção dos sistemas de flexíveis e umbilicais, incluindo todos os subcomponentes e ferramentas de instalação associadas.

Acompanhar os subfornecedores dos fornecedores de URF, participar de auditorias de subfornecedores e assegurar que os requisitos do projeto Lapa tenham sido devidamente transmitidos, compreendidos e atendidos.

Gerenciar questões de interface relacionadas à disciplina sob sua responsabilidade, em estreita cooperação com o Gerente Técnico, a contratada de SPS e a contratada de instalação, visando à integração do sistema SURF.

Identificar necessidades de assistência técnica da Companhia e coordenar o suporte com especialistas OT/TL.

Revisar dossiês e procedimentos de qualificação e acompanhar quaisquer testes de qualificação nas disciplinas de URF e Instalação.

Manter o Gerente de UFR informado sobre quaisquer desvios, riscos ou preocupações relacionadas à disciplina, seja em aspectos técnicos, de planejamento ou de custos.

Apoiar o Gerente de UFR na avaliação técnica de solicitações de alteração contratual (Change Order Requests) .

Reportar ao Gerente de UFR o progresso da disciplina .

Acompanhar as atividades dos fornecedores de URF e das contratadas de instalação durante as campanhas de instalação, incluindo mobilização e aceitação de embarcações , com participação de especialistas da matriz da TotalEnergies.

Apoiar a resolução de questões offshore durante as campanhas de instalação e coordenar o suporte das contratadas de instalação, da base logística, da contratada de SPS e do site de Lapa (FPSO).

Garantir que o estado da arte , os referenciais técnicos da TotalEnergies e as leis e normas locais sejam cumpridos e incorporados a todos os requisitos contratuais de aquisição e instalação, bem como assegurar sua aplicação durante a execução dos contratos em todos os aspectos relacionados à instalação. Fornecer suporte técnico à área de HSE da subsidiária TotalEnergies Brasil para a aceitação de embarcações de instalação.

Buscar otimizações e economias ao longo das diferentes fases do projeto, mantendo foco na redução de custos sem comprometer os objetivos de HSEQ .

title: MECANICO DE REFRIGERAÇÃO (BANCO DE TALENTOS)
description:
O Mecânico de Refrigeração é responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização, como ar-condicionado, câmaras frigoríficas, freezers e outros equipamentos similares. Este profissional assegura o funcionamento eficiente e seguro dos sistemas de refrigeração, realizando diagnósticos, trocas de componentes e ajustes técnicos necessários para manter os ambientes adequadamente refrigerados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar a instalação de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado em ambientes comerciais, industriais e residenciais, seguindo as normas técnicas e de segurança.
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em equipamentos de refrigeração, identificando problemas, realizando ajustes, substituição de peças e limpeza de componentes para garantir o desempenho ideal.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de refrigeração para detectar falhas, vazamentos de gás, problemas elétricos e mecânicos, utilizando ferramentas específicas para diagnósticos precisos.
  • Realizar reparos em compressores, condensadores, evaporadores, válvulas de expansão e demais componentes dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo a restauração completa do equipamento.
  • Realizar a carga e recarga de gás refrigerante nos sistemas, conforme as especificações técnicas e normas ambientais.
  • Testar e ajustar os equipamentos após a instalação ou reparo, verificando a temperatura, pressão, fluxo de ar e outros parâmetros para assegurar o funcionamento correto.
  • Preencher relatórios de serviços realizados, registrando as atividades de manutenção, peças substituídas e recomendações para futuras intervenções.
  • Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no trabalho, utilizando os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e adotando práticas seguras durante a execução das tarefas.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos clientes, orientando sobre o uso correto dos equipamentos e explicando as intervenções realizadas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Curso técnico ou profissionalizante em Refrigeração e Climatização.
  • Experiência comprovada na instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos e mecânicos de refrigeração.
  • Habilidade para realizar diagnósticos de falhas e executar reparos em componentes complexos.
  • Carteira de habilitação (Categoria B) pode ser exigida para deslocamento até os locais de serviço.

Overview

Se você é movido por desafios, tem olhar analítico, gosta de atuar com diferentes áreas e se realiza ao acompanhar projetos que impactam diretamente o portfólio de uma grande indústria farmacêutica, essa oportunidade é para você!

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina e uma das cinco maiores da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica, com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano.

Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atuamos em dois segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição (RX) e Autocuidado (OTC).

A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, segue construindo sua história com inovação, excelência e compromisso com a saúde, autoestima e bem-estar de milhões de pessoas.

Local de trabalho: Jacaré / Rio de Janeiro – RJ (100% presencial)

Descrição Sumária

Responsável por desenvolver novos projetos de medicamentos para lançamento de produtos e manutenção do portfólio, considerando os princípios de ciclo de vida dos produtos. Realiza solicitações de cadastro de insumos e produtos, elabora pareceres farmacotécnicos, sugere classificações fiscais de mercadorias, pesquisa atualizações de excipientes, conduz pesquisas bibliográficas e análises de risco. Atua na fabricação e orientação de lotes de bancada (nível laboratorial) e lotes piloto (nível industrial).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Identificar oportunidades de ampliação do portfólio da FQM, captando e desenvolvendo ideias que subsidiem a elaboração de propostas técnicas de novas formulações.
  • Realizar pesquisas e levantamentos técnicos sobre produtos em avaliação, reunindo dados que sustentem o desenvolvimento adequado de fórmulas e processos produtivos.
  • Iniciar projetos propostos, prospectando fornecedores de insumos e serviços, estabelecendo canais de relacionamento e garantindo a execução de testes de bancada.
  • Conduzir a preparação de lotes piloto, realizando estudos de estabilidade para assegurar a consistência dos resultados e mitigar riscos de desvios.
  • Elaborar dossiês de desenvolvimento, compilando documentos referentes às atividades e processos relacionados à formulação e à produção.
  • Finalizar o desenvolvimento de fórmulas e processos sob sua responsabilidade, transferindo o conhecimento técnico necessário para viabilizar a reprodução industrial do produto.

Requisitos de Acesso

  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Farmácia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação na área será considerada um diferencial.
  • Experiência: De 3 a 4 anos na função.
  • Idiomas: Inglês e espanhol desejáveis.

Conhecimentos Específicos

  • Desenvolvimento galênico, farmacotécnica e ciclo de vida de produtos farmacêuticos.
  • Interface com áreas como Desenvolvimento Analítico, Qualidade, Produção e Assuntos Regulatórios.
  • Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL), Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e rotinas de P&D farmacêutico.
  • Estudos de estabilidade, testes de bancada e preparação de lotes piloto.
  • Técnicas de análises de risco aplicadas ao desenvolvimento (QbD, FMEA, Ishikawa).
  • Pesquisa bibliográfica científica, seleção de excipientes e avaliação de fornecedores.
  • Elaboração de dossiês técnicos, pareceres farmacotécnicos e documentação regulatória.

title: Estágio em Tecnologia
description:
Overview

Programa de estágio em Tecnologia com duração prevista de até dois anos, sendo o primeiro ano na área de infraestrutura e o segundo ano na área de desenvolvimento de software. Excelente oportunidade de crescimento na área de tecnologia, com um programa de aprendizagem personalizado durante dois anos, ao final dos quais está prevista a efetivação como trainee. Estágio em Tecnologia para alunos de graduação em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos de tecnologia. Alunos(as) matriculados(as), com frequência comprovada, cursando no mínimo o 2º período da faculdade e há um ano e meio da data de conclusão da sua graduação. O estágio é realizado em formato híbrido, com o 1º ano presencial e o 2º ano potencialmente remoto. De segunda a sexta-feira, seis horas diárias, em horário flexível. O Instituto Infnet oferece ambiente universitário voltado a Engenharias Tech, Ciência de Dados, Comunicação e Design Digital, com oportunidades de contratação ao final do estágio e bolsas para continuar os estudos na instituição. Possível acesso à biblioteca e networking com professores e profissionais da área.

Responsibilities

  • Interagir com setores multidisciplinares: comunicar-se de forma eficaz com diferentes departamentos do Instituto Infnet, entendendo suas necessidades tecnológicas e oferecendo soluções adequadas.
  • Apoiar projetos internos de desenvolvimento web: participar de iniciativas relacionadas a sistemas de gestão de ativos e servidores web, auxiliando na implementação e manutenção dessas soluções.
  • Contribuir para projetos de automação: auxiliar na criação e manutenção de fluxos automatizados utilizando a plataforma n8n, integrando diversos serviços e otimizando processos internos.
  • Desenvolver scripts e automações com Google Apps Script: apoiar na criação de scripts para automação de tarefas no Google Planilhas e outras ferramentas do Google Workspace.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos usuários: atendimento de primeiro nível, solucionando problemas de hardware, software e conectividade, presencialmente e remotamente.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Infraestrutura e Suporte: trabalhar com os times de Infraestrutura e Suporte, contribuindo para melhoria contínua dos serviços.
  • Participar das rotinas presenciais do departamento de TI: atuar em atividades como checklists, estudo e documentação de novos processos e apoio às entregas da equipe de TI.

Ano 2 - Remoto, híbrido ou presencial, a combinar

  • Apoiar na personalização e integração de soluções usando as plataformas WordPress e Moodle.
  • Contribuir na atualização de aplicativos móveis desenvolvidos em React Native, em tarefas supervisionadas.
  • Acompanhar a implementação de soluções voltadas ao e-commerce e ensino online, envolvendo cursos de graduação, pós-graduação e intensivos.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção da infraestrutura em nuvem, visando bom desempenho e segurança.
  • Trabalhar com times multidisciplinares para alinhar soluções tecnológicas aos objetivos educacionais e comerciais.
  • Apoiar na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos simples, com foco nas integrações entre sistemas e plataformas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Cursar graduação em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos de tecnologia;
  • Estar, no mínimo, no 2º período e estar, no mínimo, um ano e meio da conclusão da graduação;

Desejáveis:

  • Inglês para leitura e escrita;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal;
  • Trabalhar bem em equipe, colaborando com membros técnicos e clientes finais.

Informações adicionais

  • Bolsa auxílio: R$ 1.300,00 no primeiro ano; R$ 1.600,00 no segundo ano.
  • Vale-transporte para os dias presenciais;
  • Dia livre de aniversário a partir de um ano de casa;
  • Bolsas parciais de estudos em cursos da instituição.

Basic Function

The Medical Assistant (MA) supports healthcare providers in an outpatient clinic by performing both clinical and administrative duties. This role ensures efficient patient flow, accurate documentation, and high-quality patient care in a fast-paced ambulatory setting.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Prepare patients for examinations and procedures

  • Ensure proper handling and labeling of specimens

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of examination, diagnostic and treatment room procedures.
  • Knowledge of Medical Terminology.
  • Knowledgeable in the use of CPT and ICD-9 code reference books.
  • Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Demonstrated skill in oral and written communications as well as ability to speak clearly.
  • Skill in assisting in a variety of treatments and medications as directed.
  • Skill in taking vital signs.
  • Skill in maintaining records and recording test results.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with patients, medical staff, and the public.
  • Ability to be detailed oriented, follow established priorities or procedures, and deliver quality customer service.
  • Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions and behave with tact, decorum and diplomacy.
  • Ability to maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations.
  • Ability to read, understand and respond to oral and written instructions.

Minimum Requirements

Associate’s degree in Medical Technology, Nursing or related field or two (2) years related experience in a physician’s office, clinic and/or hospital or equivalent combination of education and experience. Certification or Registration as a Medical Technology also required.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.

O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.

Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.

Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.

Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.

O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP.
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ).
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile.
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass).
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde.
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING CONDITIONS- Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.- Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.- Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.- Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.QUALIFICATIONSRequired- Bachelor’s degree- 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.- Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.- Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.- Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.- Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.- Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.- Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred- Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.- Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions- Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.- Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HEREConservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;
everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on

title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Coordenador De Operações
description:
Coordenador de Operações Comerciais (Sales Ops / RevOps) | Lobie


Lobie | Centro - Rio de Janeiro


A Lobie está em plena expansão no mercado de short-term rental no Rio de Janeiro. Nosso desafio atual não é apenas vender, mas garantir a eficiência máxima na implementação. Buscamos um(a) profissional focado em processos e dados para ser o "dono" da jornada entre a assinatura do contrato e a geração de receita.


Missão do cargo

Gestão do Pipeline de Ativação:

  • Estruturar e manter o pipeline no ActiveCampaign com estágios claros: Assinado → Documentação → Setup (mobília/chaves) → Fotos/Anúncio → Plataformas → Ativo.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs por estágio (ex.: máx. 15 dias em “Setup”, máx. 10 dias em “Plataformas”).
  • Configurar automações de alerta: quando um deal estoura o SLA, notificação automática para o vendedor responsável e para o Diretor Comercial.
  • Acompanhar cada unidade individualmente, cobrando as áreas responsáveis (comercial, operacional, tech) para destravar.
  • Manter o CRM como fonte única de verdade: todo contrato entra, todo distrato sai, toda ativação é registrada.


Reconciliação de Dados:

  • Cruzamento semanal entre Extranet (UHs ativas), BD Repasse (UHs com receita) e planilhas comerciais (contratos assinados).
  • Publicação do Report Semanal de Ativação: lista de UHs travadas, com nome do vendedor responsável, dias parado, estágio atual, e próxima ação necessária.
  • Alimentar o Painel de Metas com dados atualizados de taxa de ativação individual por vendedor.
  • Identificar e escalar unidades “órfãs” (vendedor saiu, cliente sem atendimento) em até 24h.


Processos e Handoff:

  • Criar e manter o protocolo de transferência de carteira: quando um vendedor sai, 100% dos seus deals ativos são redistribuídos em 24h.
  • Documentar o processo padrão de ativação ponta a ponta (playbook).
  • Coordenar a interface entre comercial e operacional no momento do handoff pós-assinatura.
  • Propor melhorias de processo com base em dados: identificar os estágios com maior tempo de permanência e atacar as causas-raiz.


Report e Análise:

  • Report mensal para a diretoria: taxa de ativação, tempo médio por estágio, receita potencial não capturada, ranking de vendedores.
  • Análise de coorte: acompanhar a “safra” de contratos assinados em cada mês e seu progresso até ativação.
  • Sugerir ações corretivas baseadas em dados



Perfil Desejado

Indispensável:

  • Experiência com CRM (ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar) — não apenas como usuário, mas configurando pipelines e automações.
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado: PROCV, tabelas dinâmicas, dashboards.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a processo.
  • Capacidade de organizar informação caótica em sistema claro.
  • Comunicação assertiva.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar como PJ.


Desejável:

  • Background em operações, CS (Customer Success), ou RevOps de SaaS/proptech/hospitality.
  • Familiaridade com Looker Studio, SQL básico, ou ferramentas de BI.
  • Experiência no mercado imobiliário ou de short-term rental.
  • Capacidade de criar automações simples (Zapier, Make, Apps Script).


Ferramentas:

  • ActiveCampaign (CRM principal — vai ser o sistema-mestre desta função)
  • Extranet Lobie (sistema de gestão de unidades)
  • Google Sheets / Looker Studio (dashboards e reports)
  • WhatsApp Business (comunicação com vendedores e time operacional)
  • BD Repasse (base de dados de receita — CSV/Excel)


Primeiros 90 Dias

Dias 1–30: Imersão e Diagnóstico

Mapear 100% dos contratos assinados e classificar status atual de cada um.

Estruturar o pipeline no ActiveCampaign com estágios e automações básicas.

Publicar o primeiro Report Semanal de Ativação.

Resolver as 10 UHs mais críticas (maior tempo parado + maior receita potencial).


Dias 31–60: Ritmo

Pipeline 100% populado e com atualização diária.

Automações de SLA funcionando: alertas disparando automaticamente.

Protocolo de transferência de carteira documentado e testado.

Reconciliação semanal rodando consistentemente.


Dias 61–90: Resultado

Taxa de ativação subindo visivelmente (meta: +8 pontos percentuais vs. baseline).

Zero unidades “órfãs” no sistema (toda UH tem dono claro).

Report mensal para diretoria no formato definitivo.

Proposta de melhorias de processo baseada nos dados dos primeiros 90 dias.

title: Senior Consultant
description:

  • Ability to work autonomously while also collaborating effectively in a fast-paced team setting.
  • Well-established professional network within key institutions, including but not limited to the Central Bank and the National Congress.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)

Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.


About Clinergy

Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.


We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.


Role Description

We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.


Activities

  • Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
  • Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
  • Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
  • Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
  • Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
  • Ensure no studytasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
  • Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor;
    Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
  • Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
  • Verify the accuracy of study results;
  • Identify and resolve site issues;


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences;
  • 2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies (Mandatory);
  • Advanced/Fluentin English;
  • Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
  • Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
  • Strong computer skills including EDC system experience

Skills

description:

Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog,, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows

Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

Logs e Analytics;

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
    postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
    fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

Technical Support and Troubleshooting - Provide technical support and troubleshooting for FICA, Convergent Invoicing, and Payment Services integration issues. - Develop and implement solutions to optimize system performance and resolve discrepancies. Documentation and Training - Create detailed documentation for system configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures. - Conduct training sessions for end-users and internal teams on SAP BRIM functionalities and best practices. Collaboration and Communication: - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including finance, IT, and operations, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of processes. - Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements. Qualifications: Education: Minimum of bachelor’s degree in finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Experience: - Minimum of 10 years of experience in FICA within the SAP BRIM environment. - Proven experience with Convergent Invoicing and Payment Services integration. - Demonstrated expertise in integrating payment services with SAP BRIM and other SAP modules. Technical Skills: - In-depth knowledge of SAP BRIM components and architecture. - Proficiency in FICA configuration, Convergent Invoicing processes, and Payment Services integration. - Strong understanding of financial processes, billing, revenue management, and payment workflows. Soft Skills: - Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. - Strong communication and interpersonal skills. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience with SAP S/4HANA. - Prior experience in industries such as telecommunications, utilities, or media. - Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Staff Engineer você será uma referência técnica transversal, com forte influência sobre decisões arquiteturais, padrões de engenharia e evolução da plataforma que sustenta todos os times de produto.

Você não estará focado em uma squad específica, mas sim em elevar o sistema como um todo: confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança, developer experience e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Influenciar e guiar decisões arquiteturais de médio e longo prazo da plataforma
  • Definir e evoluir padrões técnicos para serviços, infraestrutura, observabilidade e CI/CD
  • Atuar como guardião da qualidade técnica, reduzindo complexidade e dívida técnica
  • Trabalhar próximo a Tech Leads, SREs e Tech Managers, ajudando a desambiguar decisões difíceis
  • Projetar e evoluir plataformas e serviços compartilhados (infra, pipelines, templates, SDKs, ferramentas internas)
  • Garantir alta confiabilidade, escalabilidade e segurança dos sistemas em produção
  • Atuar fortemente em observabilidade, troubleshooting e resposta a incidentes críticos
  • Promover uma excelente Developer Experience, melhorando fluxos de build, deploy, testes e operação
  • Mentorar engenheiros(as) de diferentes níveis, elevando o padrão técnico da organização
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas elegantes, incrementais e sustentáveis
  • Tomar decisões orientadas por métricas, dados e impacto real no negócio


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência sólida como engenheiro(a) sênior / staff / principal
  • Forte domínio em Node.Js e Typescript.
  • Experiência profunda com arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos
  • Sólido conhecimento em Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure)
  • Excelente domínio de observabilidade, troubleshooting e sistemas em produção
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e mentoria
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas complexas equilibrando negócio, engenharia e operação


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você:


  • Já atuou fortemente em times de plataforma ou SRE
  • Já trabalhou em projetos de grande porte utilizando Python
  • Tem experiência com arquiteturas event-driven
  • Conhece e aplica DDD, Clean Architecture e Ports & Adapters
  • Já liderou iniciativas transversais de engenharia
  • Consegue explicar decisões técnicas complexas de forma simples


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD
  • PLR

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

******TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS SÃO ELEGÍVEIS PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA E REABILITADOS INSS.******

– Executar limpeza concorrente nos setores conforme a rotina diária, de acordo com procedimento estabelecido, para adequada manutenção da organização e limpeza do contrato;

– Organizar o DML (depósito de material limpo) e o material de limpeza, carinho funcional e/ou balaio, de acordo com a padronização estabelecida;

– Seguir os cronogramas preestabelecido, diário, semanal e mensal;

– Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados;

– Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

– ESCOLARIDADE MÍNIMO: Ensino Fundamental Incompleto.
– DESEJÁVEL: Ensino Fundamental Completo.

title: Polidor Automotivo
description:
Descrição

Você é apaixonado pelo universo automotivo e busca uma oportunidade para mostrar suas habilidades? Temos uma posição especial esperando por você! Em nosso time, você terá a chance de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador, rodeado por profissionais que compartilham o mesmo entusiasmo pela excelência em serviços automotivos. Aqui, valorizamos o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, oferecendo treinamentos constantes e um espaço para crescer junto com a empresa. Acreditamos que cada detalhe conta na jornada de transformar veículos, e você pode fazer parte desse processo. Se deseja contribuir para fazer a diferença na experiência dos nossos clientes e aprimorar suas técnicas, esperamos seu contato. Venha fazer parte de uma equipe onde seu talento será reconhecido e onde o seu trabalho impactará diretamente a satisfação e a fidelização dos nossos consumidores. Junte-se a nós e transforme sua paixão em uma carreira de sucesso!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar polimento técnico e espelhamento de veículos após a pintura; Efetuar processos de lixamento, cristalização e acabamento final; Avaliar o estado da pintura e identificar correções necessárias; Utilizar produtos e equipamentos de polimento de forma adequada e segura; Garantir a qualidade do acabamento e a satisfação do cliente; Manter o ambiente de trabalho limpo, organizado e seguro.

Requisitos e qualificações

Insalubridade Ensino médio completo Experiência comprovada de 03 anos como polidor automotivo; Conhecimento em técnicas de polimento, cristalização e vitrificação; Capacidade de identificar diferentes tipos de pintura e verniz; Comprometimento com a excelência no resultado final. Noções de segurança no trabalho e uso correto de EPIs Conhecimento básico sobre produtos automotivos (compostos, boinas, ceras) Atenção aos detalhes e capricho no acabamento Organização e cuidado com ferramentas e materiais Comprometimento com prazos e qualidade do serviço Responsabilidade e zelo com o veículo do associado Capacidade de seguir padrões e procedimentos
